purpose: Define the gate between source-status signals and public current-status claims.
required_for_public_current_status: terminal or latest governing order/docket entry where applicable
scope classification: full termination, partial termination, motion, sustainment, dismissal, agreement completion, retraction, closure
hard_rules: A status candidate is not a status claim.
A motion is not an order.
A press release is not a docket.
Closure/retraction does not erase public-record history.
Mixed-agency rows require child status objects.
